title: CNC panel bender
subtitle: Four-side bending of blanks to 79 × 49″ · 14 ga mild steel, 16 ga stainless, 1/8″ aluminum · 15 servo axes
cover_line: Dener Makina · made in Turkey · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_title: Boxes, doors and panels in one setup — no tooling, no skilled operator
about_text: A panel bender clamps the blank with a blank-holder and a bending blade folds each flange up or down, hems it or forms a box corner in 0.2 s, while a servo manipulator turns the part to the next side: all four sides of a box, door, enclosure or HVAC panel are formed in one setup with no tooling changes. The Dener panel bender takes blanks to 78.7 × 49.2″ (2,000 × 1,250 mm) in 14 ga mild steel, 16 ga stainless and 1/8″ aluminum, with flanges to 6.7″ (11.8″ on request), a 1 mm minimum radius and 0.001 mm positioning on 15 servo axes; 100 % electric, it draws about 2.8 kW on average at 50 dB. Automatic loading and unloading arms turn it into an unattended cell behind a laser.

Dener Makina has built sheet-metal machinery in Kayseri since 1974 and exports to more than 100 countries. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the panel bender in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts stocked by Dener Canada.
